profile_text.body:
Microsoft is a public company founded in 1975 and headquartered in Redmond, WA, with a ticker of MSFT and a CIK of 0000789019. Its most recently reported annual revenue, covering the period ending June 30, 2026, was $331,839,000,000. The company's website, in the context of this profile, focuses on Power Automate, which Microsoft describes as a tool for automating workflows and business processes across apps, systems, and websites using AI-powered, digital, and robotic process automation.

Microsoft tracks a broad portfolio of AI products across several categories. These include Microsoft Power Automate AI, an enterprise workflow automation product with Copilot and data loss prevention integration; Microsoft Copilot, embedded across Microsoft 365; Azure OpenAI Service, which provides OpenAI models within Azure infrastructure with enterprise content filtering and data residency controls; Azure Machine Learning, an MLOps platform with AutoML and a model registry; and developer-oriented tools including AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, and the Microsoft Agent Framework, the last of which is described as the successor to both Semantic Kernel and AutoGen and is noted to offer native MCP and A2A support. Additional products include Microsoft Designer for image and design generation, Microsoft Teams AI for meeting recaps and Copilot integration, SharePoint AI for enterprise content management, and Microsoft Clipchamp AI for video editing.

On the legal side, Microsoft is a named defendant in The New York Times Co. v. Microsoft Corp. and OpenAI, filed in the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York, and is also connected to Authors Guild v. OpenAI, Inc. in the same court. The held facts record 72 legal exposure items associated with Washington state.
